discord-botlists.name: discord-botlists
discord-botlists.label: discord-botlists
discord-botlists.description: Universal multi-botlist SDK for Discord bots: post stats to 27 verified live lists, get votes in realtime, parse every API into one shape.

lootifyr.name: lootifyr
lootifyr.label: Lootifyr
lootifyr.description: Ded3ec-Store streamlines offer distribution across major e-commerce platforms including Amazon and Flipkart. Sellers, affiliates, and automated systems dispatch promotional offers (discounts, deals, custom listings) to multiple marketplaces from a unified interface or API.

pyrlune.name: pyrlune
pyrlune.label: Pyrlune
pyrlune.description: Jericho is a powerful, customizable Discord bot built to make your server smarter, smoother, and way more fun. Designed with modularity and performance in mind, it delivers fast responses, handy utilities, and a growing suite of features for community management and entertainment.

authcore.name: authcore
authcore.label: AuthCore
authcore.description: AuthCore is a lightweight, server-side authentication framework for Fabric servers, enabling secure player registration and login workflows on offline-mode servers with modular, configurable, and version-safe design.

statfyr.name: statfyr
statfyr.label: statfyr
statfyr.description: Statfyr is a fast REST API plugin for Minecraft that exposes player statistics through a clean, documented interface. It enables developers to build dashboards, leaderboards, Discord integrations, and bots on real-time player data: kills, deaths, playtime, blocks mined, items crafted, and movement analytics.

ojaj.name: ojaj
ojaj.label: ojaj
ojaj.description: A chaotic Spigot plugin where a single jump launches the entire server.

echoingdeaths.name: echoingdeaths
echoingdeaths.label: EchoingDeaths
echoingdeaths.description: EchoingDeaths adds immersive death-based curses to nearby players.  Whenever a player dies, nearby players receive temporary debuffs themed around the cause of death.

customdamagenumbers.name: customdamagenumbers
customdamagenumbers.label: CustomDamageNumbers
customdamagenumbers.description: Custom Damage Numbers adds clean, animated, packet-only damage indicators to your Minecraft server. Fully configurable with hit merging, entity-following animations, styles, player toggles, and support for modern and legacy server versions.

minecraft-eggs.name: minecraft-eggs
minecraft-eggs.label: Minecraft-Eggs
minecraft-eggs.description: Universal Minecraft egg for Pterodactyl, Pelican, and Feather Panel. Supports Vanilla, Paper, Purpur, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Velocity, Bedrock, and all 18+ server types.

prog-language-eggs.name: prog-language-eggs
prog-language-eggs.label: Prog-Language-Eggs
prog-language-eggs.description: One egg. One image. Every language. A production-grade hosting platform that installs, updates, compiles and runs 50+ programming languages inside your container - across Pterodactyl, Pelican, Feather Panel, PufferPanel, Jexactyl, Wisp, Emerald, Kubernetes, Fly.io, Railway, Render

database-eggs.name: database-eggs
database-eggs.label: Database-Eggs
database-eggs.description: One egg. Every database. Every version. Every panel. Production-ready multi-database eggs for Pterodactyl, Pelican, Feather, Wisp, and Docker.

potenfyr-nest.name: potenfyr-nest
potenfyr-nest.label: potenfyr-nest
potenfyr-nest.description: Central mirror of every egg collection published by PotenFYR-Studios, kept in sync automatically from the org.

shell-eggs.name: shell-eggs
shell-eggs.label: Shell-Eggs
shell-eggs.description: Host any shell - incoming, tunneled, reversed, encrypted, covert, web or debug - from one panel egg. Credentials are the only mandatory input. Everything else is optional.

vigilfyr.name: vigilfyr
vigilfyr.label: VigilFYR
vigilfyr.description: Vigil is a local guard for AI coding agents: it sits between your agent and your filesystem and blocks reads, writes, searches, and commands that touch sensitive areas

fyrwall.name: fyrwall
fyrwall.label: FYRwall
fyrwall.description: FYRwall gives administrators a clean GUI over UFW and iptables without ever running the web server as root, without shell interpolation anywhere, and without a single firewall mutation that lacks a restore point and rollback path.

orbynode.name: orbynode
orbynode.label: OrbyNode
orbynode.description: OrbyNode is the self-hosted control plane for coding agents. It runs persistent terminal agents, owns their PTYs, files, tasks, Git workflows, services and machine state in one daemon, and reconnects your browser without interrupting the work.

readmefx.name: readmefx
readmefx.label: ReadmeFX
readmefx.description: ReadmeFX is an open-source image generation API for GitHub READMEs, developer profiles, portfolios, and Markdown documentation.

hbs-tool.name: hbs-tool
hbs-tool.label: HBS-Tool
hbs-tool.description: HBS - an offline-first, strictly read-only configuration-security review platform for enterprise servers, with a sealed-report security model.

pteroops-mcp.name: pteroops-mcp
pteroops-mcp.label: PteroOps-MCP
pteroops-mcp.description: AI-powered server management and monitoring for Pterodactyl panels using MCP.

linkfyr.name: linkfyr
linkfyr.label: LinkFYR
linkfyr.description: One control layer for what your apps do on the network: which interface carries them, how much bandwidth they get, which VPN or DNS they use, how traffic behaves when quality changes - and a full, explainable history of why.

fyrpay.name: fyrpay
fyrpay.label: FYRpay
fyrpay.description: FYRpay is an all-in-one business platform for freelancers and agencies to manage clients, proposals, projects, invoices, payments, expenses, and profitability.

assets.name: assets
assets.label: .assets
assets.description: PotenFYR's digital asset collection including logos, images and banners
